component.name: Waddle
component.summary: Chat, rooms and huddles for your communities

description.p: Waddle is a self-hostable place for communities to talk: rooms, direct messages and voice calls, built on XMPP.

Chat in rooms, direct messages and group chats with replies, threads, reactions, formatting, files, GIFs and stickers. Keep up with an unread overview, the community feed and stories, and events. Place one-to-one voice calls.
This is an early build and has not yet been run against a live server by its authors; expect rough edges.
First scaffold: sign-in with your community's provider and an adaptive shell.
